title: Rebooking Goodwill Credit on Crestline Companion Fares
content:
When Crestline has cancelled companion trips on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product, a rebooking goodwill credit is given against the companion fare. It follows the trip reinstatements on the certificate or pass whose ground is a cancellation Crestline made:

| Trip reinstatements on the certificate or pass on the ground of a Crestline cancellation | Rebooking goodwill credit |
|---|---|
| two or more | 25 USD |
| exactly one | 12 USD |
| none | nothing |

Reinstatements after a voluntary cancellation are not counted.

**Hypothetical case.** A pass with one reinstatement after a Crestline cancellation and two after voluntary cancellations gives a credit of 12 USD.
